correctness.rationale: The hyperelliptic even-subset theta model yields an exact graph interpretation. The 8 stars and 280 four-stars-plus-triangle configurations satisfy the defining triple condition, exhaust the known 288 heptads and agree with direct exhaustive 28-choose-7 enumeration. Fixed 3-subsets give the formula for all powers. The 22-partition table and independent direct 288-point orbit calculation establish injectivity of the four-count signatures and uniqueness of the three-count collision. Degree-eight and two degree-four irreducible polynomial constructions exist over every odd finite field, proving sharpness; three explicit F3 polynomials pass exact irreducibility checks.

value.rationale: The finite étale Aronhold-heptad scheme is a canonical arithmetic incidence structure associated to theta characteristics. Its first four rational point counts reconstruct a natural full branch-splitting invariant for every odd finite field, with sharp uniform obstruction exhibited by actual curves. The theorem yields a complete nontrivial 22-case classification from one configuration scheme and resolves an information-loss boundary; it is not a renaming of the known 288 count or orbit decomposition.
